description: Where the published page lives, for chat-assistant to link and to change later

title.description: The page title as the chat shows it, at most 40 characters

embed_url.description: embed_url from the last app_publish; null when it returned none

instance.description: Instance ID from app_publish, needed to change the page later

folder.description: Files folder that holds the page's source

checked.description: True when you looked at a screenshot of the published page

notes.description: What the person should know, such as sample data; empty when there is nothing
